title: Adic exceptional projection data
statement: For the operation data of [def-per-adic-exceptional-operation], the projection data is the natural isomorphism $Rf_!(K\widehat\otimes Lf^*M)\cong Rf_!K\widehat\otimes M$. Its inverse is characterized by the ordinary proper-counit/open-extension projection word and the actual completion-unit comparisons, using the tensor model [def-sf-tensor-completion-comparison]. Include compatibility with shifts in each variable. The shift equation in each variable uses exactly the recorded tensorShifts of [def-pur-integral-operation-shift-data], restricted with the canonical inclusion-shift comparisons, and the fixed pullback and support shifts; none is freely selected.
